mapper.select: select cg.id, cg.name, cg.code, cg.speciality_id, s.name as speciality_name, s.college_id, c.name as college_name from classgroup cg join speciality s on s.id = cg.speciality_id join college c on c.id = s.college_id where cg.id = #{id}

select cg.id, cg.name, cg.code, cg.speciality_id, s.name as speciality_name, s.college_id, c.name as college_name from classgroup cg join speciality s on s.id = cg.speciality_id join college c on c.id = s.college_id order by cg.id desc
select id, name, code, speciality_id as specialityId from classgroup order by id desc
mapper.insert: insert into classgroup(name, code, speciality_id) values(#{name}, #{code}, #{specialityId})
